categories.main_business_segments: Conagra Brands operates through four primary business segments: Grocery & Snacks (branded, shelf-stable food products in U.S. retail channels), Refrigerated & Frozen (branded, temperature-controlled food products in U.S. retail channels), International (branded food products in various temperature states sold outside the U.S.), and Foodservice (branded and customized food products for restaurants and foodservice establishments, primarily in the U.S.).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes large-scale food manufacturing and processing technologies, including both shelf-stable and temperature-controlled production. It leverages automation, connected data, and investments in new equipment and artificial intelligence to enhance productivity and efficiency. Conagra also employs commodity hedging and productivity initiatives to manage input cost volatility.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Conagra serves a wide range of customers, including chain, wholesale, value, cooperative, club, and independent grocery stores, as well as pharmacy, drug, convenience, and other retailers. Foodservice customers include restaurants, bars, schools, healthcare facilities, government entities, and travel/leisure operators. Walmart, Inc. is its largest customer, accounting for 29% of net sales in fiscal 2025.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily in North America, with the majority of sales and manufacturing in the United States. It also has international operations and sales in Canada, Mexico, Panama, the Philippines, and other markets, with foreign net sales of approximately $988 million in fiscal 2025.
categories.supply_chain_position: Conagra Brands operates primarily as a downstream player in the supply chain, focusing on branded consumer packaged goods. It sources raw materials and commodities, processes and manufactures finished food products, and distributes them to retailers and foodservice customers. The company also utilizes contract manufacturing and third-party logistics providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Conagra’s strategic priorities include driving sustainable, profitable growth through brand innovation, productivity improvements, and expansion into adjacent categories. The company invests in R&D to adapt to changing consumer preferences, enhance product quality, and develop new products and packaging. Digital transformation, automation, and supply chain optimization are also key focus areas.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of branded food products to retailers, foodservice operators, and distributors. Revenue is recognized upon delivery of goods, and the company also receives income from licensing agreements and joint ventures. Trade promotions, advertising, and consumer incentives are integral to its revenue generation strategy.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Conagra faces intense competition from other major branded food companies, private label producers, and new entrants, particularly in the highly competitive U.S. food industry. Key competitors include Kraft Heinz, General Mills, Nestlé, Campbell Soup, and private label/store brands. Conagra positions itself as a leading branded food company with a focus on quality, innovation, and value.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2025, Conagra reported net sales of $11.6 billion and net income of $1.15 billion. The company experienced a 3.6% decline in net sales compared to the prior year, reflecting volume and price/mix pressures, input cost inflation, and supply chain challenges. Despite recent declines, Conagra maintains a large scale and continues to invest in growth and productivity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Conagra emphasizes its portfolio of well-known, trusted brands, product quality, and continuous innovation to meet evolving consumer preferences. The company differentiates itself through brand recognition, product variety, and a focus on value-added, convenient food solutions. Its ability to adapt to consumer trends and invest in R&D and supply chain efficiency supports its competitive advantage.
